papers.title: On the unirationality of anticanonical weighted complete intersection surfaces: the infinite families
notes: Giulia Gugiatti is a student of Corti and Coates
papers.snippet: Anticanonical weighted complete intersection surfaces fall into finitely many sporadic families and four infinite families. We prove that the anticanonical surfaces lying in the infinite families are unirational over their field of definition. Over a Hilbertian field, we further prove that a Hilbert subset of members consists of nonrational surfaces.

papers.title: Theta Functions and Intrinsic Mirrors of Laurent Phenomenon Algebras
papers.snippet: We construct bases of upper Laurent phenomenon algebras over a field by minimizing Newton polytopes in a single seed. For any translation-invariant total order on the exponents, each least exponent $a$ that occurs determines a smallest Newton polytope $Q_a$. Choose one element with Newton polytope $Q_a$ and least term $x^a$ for each such $a$. These elements form a basis.

papers.title: Uniform Algebraic Degeneracy of Entire Curves into Complex Projective Varieties
papers.snippet: This paper is devoted to the algebraic degeneracy of entire curves intersecting a simple-normal-crossing divisor on smooth projective varieties over C, within the logarithmic Green-Griffiths-Lang program.

papers.title: Virasoro operators for relative Gromov--Witten theory
papers.authors: Shuai Guo, Longting Wu, Lei You
papers.snippet: Let $D$ be a smooth divisor in a smooth projective variety $X$. We construct relative Virasoro operators acting on the relative descendant potential of $(X,D)$. Each operator is the logarithmic Virasoro operator of $(X,D)$ plus a boundary correction determined only by $D$ and its normal bundle in $X$.

papers.title: Equivariant Localization for $K(n)$-Local Gromov-Witten Invariants with Applications to Gopakumar-Vafa Invariants
papers.snippet: For certain complex-oriented $K(n)$-local cohomology theories, we establish equivariant localization formulas for global Kuranishi charts and a Riemann-Roch formula.

papers.title: Tropical limits of holomorphic linking for toric hypersurfaces and points
papers.snippet: A holomorphic top form on a smooth hypersurface in a smooth projective toric variety has a unique meromorphic residue lift when the ambient dimension is at least two. Evaluating this lift at a point, relative to the logarithmic volume form, gives a complex linking number.

papers.title: Spaces of ratios of schemes and \'etale cohomology
papers.authors: Kazuya Kato, Chikara Nakayama, Sampei Usui
papers.snippet: We introduce the arithmetic topologies on the spaces of ratios for log schemes and prove the basic properties of their cohomologies.

papers.title: Rank-Two Attractors and Modularity for a Mirror Bicubic
papers.snippet: We study the mirror family $\mathcal X_\lambda$ of the bicubic Calabi-Yau threefold, obtained from a family of complete intersections of two cubics in $\mathbb P^5$. We show that the four-dimensional weight-three Hodge structure of the fibers over $\lambda^6 = -8$ splits into two rational rank-two pieces of Hodge types $(1,0,0,1)$ and $(0,1,1,0)$; in particular, these points are rank-two attractor points.

papers.title: Euler Characteristics of Perverse Sheaves on Complex Ball Quotients
papers.snippet: Let $X=\Gamma\backslash\mathbb{B}^n$ be a finite-volume complex ball quotient with neat lattice. We prove that every nonzero algebraically constructible perverse sheaf on $X$ has positive Euler characteristic.

papers.title: A Determinant Proof of the Sun--Yang--Zuo Conjecture
papers.snippet: We give an elementary proof of the determinant identity in \cite[Conjecture~A.1]{SYZ} over any field of odd characteristic $p$. The proof computes the determinant of a single linear map by dividing by two different monic polynomials. By \cite[Proposition~A.9]{SYZ}, the identity gives another proof of the Sun--Yang--Zuo conjecture.

papers.title: Combinatorics of equivariant blowups of spherical varieties
papers.snippet: We explicitly describe the colored fan of the blowup of a smooth spherical variety $X$ along a smooth irreducible $G$-stable subvariety $Y$. The answer is expressed in terms of the colored cone of $Y$ and the localization of the valuation cone at $Y$, and generalizes the star subdivision of fans of toric varieties. We also consider several examples illustrating the main result.

papers.title: Combinatorial relative orientability for toric and tropical geometry
papers.snippet: Many problems in enumerative geometry are solved by computing the degree of the top Chern class of a suitable vector bundle. Results from $\mathbb{A}^1$-homotopy theory allow to answer enumerative questions over arbitrary fields, replacing the top Chern class by the Euler class in Chow-Witt groups. For its degree to be well-defined, one needs the vector bundle to be relatively oriented.
